original: pūrvapakṣīyavyāptilakṣaṇam -- "sādhyābhāvavadavṛttitvam"| sādhyaṃ vahniḥ, tadabhāvavān hradaḥ, tadvṛttitvaṃ mīnaśaivālādiṣu, avṛttitvaṃ dhūme iti lakṣaṇasamanvayaḥ| sādhyābhāvavannirupitāvṛttitvaṃ vyāptiriti niṣkṛṣṭo'rthaḥ|
analyzed: pūrvapakṣīya vyāpti lakṣaṇam sādhya abhāvavat avṛtti tvam sādhyam vahniḥ tad abhāvavān hradaḥ tad vṛtti tvam mīna śaivāla ādiṣu avṛtti tvam dhūme iti lakṣaṇa samanvayaḥ sādhya abhāvavat nirupita avṛtti tvam vyāptiḥ iti niṣkṛṣṭa ṛthaḥ

original: evamukte'pi "samavāyasambandhena vahnirmahānase nāsti" iti pratītyā vahnyabhāvavān mahānasaḥ tadvṛttitvameva dhūme iti avyāptiḥ,tadvāraṇāya sādhyaniṣṭhapratiyogitāyāṃ sādhyatāvacchedakasambandhāvacchinnatvaviśeṣaṇaṃ dīyate|tathā sati sādhyo vahniḥ parvate saṃyogena siṣādhayiṣito'stīti sādhyatāvacchedakasambandhaḥ saṃyogaḥ|
analyzed: evam ukte api samavāya sambandhena vahniḥ mahānase na asti iti pratītyā vahni abhāvavān mahānasaḥ tad vṛtti tvam eva dhūme iti avyāptiḥ tad vāraṇāya sādhya niṣṭha pratiyogitāyām sādhya tā avacchedaka sambandha avacchinna tva viśeṣaṇam dīyate tathā sati sādhyaḥ vahniḥ parvate saṃyogena siṣādhayiṣitaḥ asti iti sādhya tā avacchedaka sambandhaḥ saṃyogaḥ
atas saṃyoga sambandha avacchinna sādhya niṣṭha pratiyogitāka abhāvaḥ mahānase na asti iti na avyāptiḥ

original: evamukte'pi -- mahānase catvarīyavahnirvāsti iti pratītyā (cālanīnyāyena) mahānase vahnyabhāvaṃ sādhayitvā tadvṛttitvaṃ dhūme iti punaravyāptiḥ| tadvāraṇāya sādhyatāvacchedakāvacchinnatvaviśeṣaṇaṃ pratiyogitāyāṃ niveśyate|tathā sati mahānase vahnitvāvacchinnapratiyogitākābhāvo nāstīti nāvyāptiḥ|
analyzed: evam ukte api mahānase catvarīya vahniḥ vā asti iti pratītyā cālanī nyāyena mahānase vahni abhāvam sādhayitvā tad vṛtti tvam dhūme iti punar avyāptiḥ tad vāraṇāya sādhya tā avacchedaka avacchinna tva viśeṣaṇam pratiyogitāyām niveśyate tathā sati mahānase vahni tva avacchinna pratiyogitāka abhāvaḥ na asti iti na avyāptiḥ

original: evamukte'pi etadvṛkṣaḥ kapisaṃyogī etadvṛkṣatvāditi saddhetau saṃyogābhāvasya vṛkṣe sattvātsamavāyasambandhāvacchinnasaṃyogatvāvacchinnasaṃyoganiṣṭhapratiyogitākābhāvāvān vṛkṣaḥ tadvṛttitvameva etadvṛkṣatve iti avyāptiḥ| tadvāraṇāya pratiyogivyadhikaraṇaviśeṣaṇamabhāve niveśyate|vyadhikaraṇañcātra tadanadhikaraṇavṛttitvam|
analyzed: evam ukte api etad vṛkṣaḥ kapi saṃyogī etad vṛkṣa tvāt iti sat hetau saṃyoga abhāvasya vṛkṣe sattvāt samavāya sambandha avacchinna saṃyoga tva avacchinna saṃyoga niṣṭha pratiyogitāka abhāvāvān vṛkṣaḥ tad vṛtti tvam eva etad vṛkṣa tve iti avyāptiḥ tad vāraṇāya pratiyogi vyadhikaraṇa viśeṣaṇam abhāve niveśyate vyadhikaraṇam ca atra tad anadhikaraṇa vṛtti tvam

original: tatpadena sādhyaḥ kapisaṃyogo gṛhyate| tadadhikaraṇametadvṛkṣaḥ anadhikaraṇaṃ guṇaḥ, tadvṛttirabhāvaḥ saṃyogābhāvaḥ, tadvadavṛttitvametadvṛkṣatve iti nā'vyāptiḥ|
analyzed: tad padena sādhyaḥ kapi saṃyogaḥ gṛhyate tad adhikaraṇam etad vṛkṣaḥ anadhikaraṇam guṇaḥ tad vṛttiḥ abhāvaḥ saṃyoga abhāvaḥ tadvat avṛtti tvam etad vṛkṣa tve iti na avyāptiḥ

original: evamapi "saṃyogena kapisaṃyogo vṛkṣe nāsti" iti pratītyā kapisaṃyogābhāvavān etadvṛkṣatvaṃ tadvṛttitvam etadvṛkṣatve iti punaravyāptiḥ| tadvāraṇāya pratiyoginiṣṭhādheyatāyāṃ pratiyogitāvacchedakasambandhāvacchinnatvaviśeṣaṇaṃ dīyate| sa ca sambandhaḥ sādhyatāvacchedakasambandha eva bhavati|
analyzed: evam api saṃyogena kapi saṃyogaḥ vṛkṣe na asti iti pratītyā kapi saṃyoga abhāvavān etad vṛkṣa tvam tad vṛtti tvam etad vṛkṣa tve iti punar avyāptiḥ tad vāraṇāya pratiyogi niṣṭha ādheyatāyām pratiyogitā avacchedaka sambandha avacchinna tva viśeṣaṇam dīyate sa ca sambandhaḥ sādhyatā avacchedaka sambandhaḥ eva bhavati

evam ca samavāya sambandha avacchinna saṃyo tva avacchinna pratiyogitāka samavāya sambandha avacchinna ādheyatāvat pratiyogi vyadhikaraṇa abhāva vat nirupita vṛtti tva abhāvaḥ vyāptiḥ iti lakṣaṇam sampannam
tena ca samavāya sambandha avacchinna ādheyatāvat pratiyogi anadhikaraṇam etad vṛkṣaḥ na bhavati iti na avyāptiḥ

original: etenāpi viśiṣṭasattvāvān jāteḥ iti vyabhicāriṇi ativyaptiḥ| tathāhi -- sādhyaṃ viśiṣṭasattā| viśiṣṭaśuddhayoranatireka iti nyāyena sattā eva sādhyā| tadabhāvavat sāmānyādikaṃ tadavṛttitvañca jātau iti jātau sattāvyāpyatvamāyātamiti ativyāptiḥ| tadvāraṇāya pratiyogitāvacchedakāvacchinnatvaviśeṣaṇaṃ pratiyoginiṣṭhādheyatāyāṃ dīyate|
analyzed: etena api viśiṣṭa sattvāvān jāteḥ iti vyabhicāriṇi ati vyaptiḥ tathā hi sādhyam viśiṣṭa sattā viśiṣṭa śuddhayoḥ anatirekaḥ iti nyāyena sattā eva sādhyā tad abhāvavat sāmānya ādikam tad avṛtti tvam ca jātau iti jātau sattā vyāpya tvam āyātam iti ativyāptiḥ tad vāraṇāya pratiyogitā avacchedaka avacchinna tva viśeṣaṇam pratiyogi niṣṭha ādheyatāyām dīyate

original: tathā sati viśiṣṭasattātvāvacchinnādheyatāvatpratiyogyanadhikaraṇaṃ guṇaḥ tadvṛttitvameva jātau na tvavṛttitvamiti ativyāptiḥ vāritā|
analyzed: tathā sati viśiṣṭa sattā tva avacchinna ādheyatāvat pratiyogi anadhikaraṇam guṇaḥ tad vṛtti tvam eva jātau na tu avṛtti tvam iti ativyāptiḥ vāritā

original: evamapi "vahnimān dhūmādi"tyatra vahnipratiyogikavahnivyadhikaraṇābhāvo dhūmāvayavagatavahnyabhāvaḥ| tadvān dhūmāvayavaḥ tadvṛttitvaṃ dhūme iti saddhetāvavyāptiḥ| tadvāraṇāya vṛttitve hetutāvacchedakasambandhāvacchinnatvaṃ viśeṣaṇaṃ dīyate| prakṛte dhūmaḥ saṃyogasambandhena pakṣe'stīti hetutāvacchedakasambandhaḥ saṃyogaḥ|
analyzed: evam api vahnimān dhūmāt iti atra vahni pratiyogika vahni vyadhikaraṇa abhāvaḥ dhūma avayava gata vahni abhāvaḥ tadvān dhūma avayavaḥ tad vṛtti tvam dhūme iti sat hetau avyāptiḥ tad vāraṇāya vṛtti tve hetu tā avacchedaka sambandha avacchinna tvam viśeṣaṇam dīyate prakṛte dhūmaḥ saṃyoga sambandhena pakṣe sti iti hetu tā avacchedaka sambandhaḥ saṃyogaḥ

original: dhūmāvayavanirūpitaṃ dhūmaniṣṭhaṃ vṛttitvaṃ samavāyasambandhāvacchinnamiti hetutāvacchedakasambandhāvacchinnavṛttitvaṃ dhūmāvayavanirupitaṃ na bhavati iti nā'vyāptiḥ|
analyzed: dhūma avayava nirūpitam dhūma niṣṭham vṛtti tvam samavāya sambandha avacchinnam iti hetu tā avacchedaka sambandha avacchinna vṛtti tvam dhūma avayava nirupitam na bhavati iti na avyāptiḥ

original: etāvadukte'pi "dhūmavān vahne"riti vyabhicārasthale'tivyāptiḥ| tadyathā -- sādhyābhāvavannirūpito vṛttitvapratiyogitāko'bhāvo nāma ayogolake vṛttitvaghaṭobhayannāstīti pratītisiddho'bhāvaḥ| ataḥ sādhyapratiyogikapratiyogivyadhikaraṇābhāvavannirūpitavṛttitvābhāvarūpāvyāptiḥ vahnau astīti ativyāptiḥ|
analyzed: etāvat ukte api dhūmavān vahneḥ iti vyabhicāra sthala iti vyāptiḥ tat yathā sādhya abhāvavat nirūpitaḥ vṛttitva pratiyogitākaḥ bhāvaḥ nāma ayaḥ golake vṛtti tva ghaṭa ubhayat na asti iti pratīti siddhaḥ bhāvaḥ atas sādhya pratiyogika pratiyogi vyadhikaraṇa abhāvavat nirūpita vṛtti tva abhāva rūpa avyāptiḥ vahnau asti iti ativyāptiḥ

original: tadvāraṇāya vṛttitvatvāvacchinnatvaviśeṣaṇaṃ deyam| tena 'ayogolake vahniniṣṭhavṛttitvaṃ nāsti' iti pratītisiddhau vṛttitvatvāvacchinnavahniniṣṭhavṛttitvapratiyogitākābhāvo nāsti iti vyāptilakṣaṇaṃ na ghaṭate iti nātivyāptiḥ|
analyzed: tad vāraṇāya vṛttitva tva avacchinna tva viśeṣaṇam deyam tena ayaḥ golake vahni niṣṭha vṛttitvam na asti iti pratīti siddhau vṛtti tva tva avacchinna vahni niṣṭha vṛttitva pratiyogitāka abhāvaḥ na asti iti vyāpti lakṣaṇam na ghaṭate iti na ativyāptiḥ

original: yattu ayogolake vahnighaṭobhayabhāvamādāya vṛttitvaniṣṭhapratiyogitākābhāvaḥ sādhitaḥ sa (vṛttitvaghaṭo)bhayatvāvacchinnapratiyogitākābhāva iti na doṣaḥ|||
analyzed: yat tu ayaḥ golake vahni ghaṭa ubhaya bhāvam ādāya vṛtti tva niṣṭha pratiyogitāka abhāvaḥ sādhitaḥ sa vṛtti tva ghaṭa ubhaya tva avacchinna pratiyogitāka abhāvaḥ iti na doṣaḥ
